title: min and max
description: Setting valid bounds on number, date, time and range inputs.
subject: html
html:
The min and max attributes set the valid lower and upper bounds for number, date, time, and range inputs.

Syntax

<input type="number" min="1" max="100">
<input type="date" min="2026-01-01" max="2026-12-31">

Basic Example

<label for="age">Age</label>
<input type="number" id="age" name="age" min="16" max="99" required>

Browser output: attempting to submit a value outside 16–99 (or leaving it empty) blocks submission with a native message stating the valid range.

How It Works

The exact meaning of min/max depends on the input's type — a plain number on number/range, or a date/time string in the required fixed format on date/time/month/week inputs.

Important Attributes

AttributePurpose
minThe lowest acceptable value
maxThe highest acceptable value
stepWorks alongside min/max to define valid increments between them

Real-World Example

<label for="rating">Rate this course (1–5)</label>
<input type="range" id="rating" name="rating" min="1" max="5" step="1" value="3">

A slider bounded to exactly the valid rating range — the user physically cannot drag it outside 1–5, since the browser enforces the bounds directly in the control's behavior.

Common Mistakes

  • Setting min higher than max by mistake, creating an impossible-to-satisfy range
  • Writing date bounds in the wrong format — see date-input for the required YYYY-MM-DD format

Best Practices

  • Set genuinely meaningful bounds based on real-world constraints, not arbitrary numbers
  • Combine with step when values should only land on specific increments

Accessibility Considerations

Screen readers can announce a field's valid range when focused, giving users the expected bounds before they even attempt to enter a value.

SEO Considerations

No direct ranking effect.

Browser & Modern HTML Notes

On some input types (like plain number), a user can still type a value outside min/max directly with the keyboard — the browser blocks it at submission time via validation, not necessarily at the moment of typing, which is a common point of confusion.

Mini Practice

  1. Build an age field bounded between 16 and 99.
  2. Build a range slider for a 1–5 star rating, using min, max, and step together.
